description: Recent event logs emitted by a contract on Ethereum over the last N blocks (up to 1,000), optionally filtered by topic0 (event signature hash). Returns up to 100 logs with block, transaction hash and topics. Use to watch transfers or contract events. Costs $0.001 in USDC on Base per successful call, paid with x402.

blocks.description: How many recent blocks to scan (1-1000, default 50)

topic0.description: Optional 0x event signature hash to filter by

name: eth_logs
